whats_new.title: SignMate is now American Sign Language (ASL)
items: SignMate now reads American Sign Language and shows and speaks the words in English. It knows 250 everyday ASL signs.

Why the change: for ASL, large collections of signs recorded with the consent of Deaf signers exist under licences that allow this use. The Pakistan Sign Language version is archived in the repository.
Every answer is still a suggestion you confirm. Nothing is spoken until you tap "Yes". Each sign says "Dataset sign — not yet validated by our reviewers" until a Deaf ASL reviewer checks it.

whats_new.title: A website, nothing to install
items: SignMate is a website only: the translator is at signmate-pk.github.io/translate/. There is no app to install and no offline copy.
The camera picture still never leaves your device: recognition runs in your browser.

whats_new.title: For now in English only
items: Urdu captions come back once an Urdu editor has reviewed them.
